item.title: Nish's Daily Reads — 2026-08-09
item.description: The fetcher returned 234 candidates. I checked primary pages for the eight kept stories and dropped repeats, stale links, self-promotional launches without enough outside evidence, and pages that could not be opened. The useful signal today is practical: AI is becoming a managed operating cost, a web operator, and a replacement layer for expensive closed systems.
